title: A wandering blacksmith hails you from his cart
description: His portable forge still glows in its iron cradle. "Road's been cruel to your kit, by the look of it. Sixty gold and I'll set it all right — dents hammered, edges honed, straps mended."

choices.text: Pay 60 gold for his best work.

onPass.narration: He works through the afternoon, humming over the anvil. Your gear sits better than it has in weeks, and the party's aches fade with the load off their shoulders.

onFail.narration: Your purse comes up short. He shrugs, not unkindly, and stokes his forge for the next traveler.

choices.text: Trade stories of the road instead.

onPass.narration: He laughs at your best tale and shares his supper — good bread, better sausage. "For the company," he says.

onFail.narration: He listens politely, then returns to his bellows. The road calls you both onward.

onPass.narration: You nod to him and keep moving. The ring of his hammer follows you down the road.
